Andrea.tagline: The only thing more precise than a bullet is my arrow.
Andrea.summary: Andrea is a Sniper. She has low damage for her class, but also high health. Her courage cost and preparation time are typical for a ranged unit. She also has very high charisma

perks.name: Does not provoke stationary zombies
perks.info: Unit will not immediately attract attention from any idle zombies at the start of a mission while moving or shooting unlike all other units, most rage abilities, and Bill's rifle. However, any enemy struck by an attack from said unit will become alert. This perk will not work against human enemies, such as marauders and enemy player units in Skirmish or the Christmas Event. This perk is exclusive to Agents and Andrea.

perks.name: High Accuracy
perks.info: Unit has a bullet spread angle of 15° or less. All sniper class units possess this perk, with Maria beng the only non-sniper to possess it.

perks.name: Knocks the enemy back
perks.info: Pushes enemies back some distance. Some units with this perk can only cause knockback with a critical hit while others can cause knockback with every hit. The distance an enemy is knocked back can vary, though most only push enemies a moderately small distance away. Knockback distance can be partially or completely resisted on certain enemies.

Agents.tagline: FDD's remains are prioritizing protecting the United States against another zombie attack.
Agents.summary: Agents are damage-oriented ranged Supports, whose main utility comes from their unique perks. Outside of those, they act strictly as extra damage dealers. Their stats are average for ranged units, and are close to those of Shooters.

perks.name: The unit is immediately available at the beginning of battle
perks.info: Unit is fully prepared to be sent out as opposed to the normal 10 seconds all other units get off their preparation time at the start of a mission. This perk is exclusive to Agents.

perks.name: Does not provoke stationary zombies
perks.info: Unit will not immediately attract attention from any idle zombies at the start of a mission while moving or shooting unlike all other units, most rage abilities, and Bill's rifle. However, any enemy struck by an attack from said unit will become alert. This perk will not work against human enemies, such as marauders and enemy player units in Skirmish or the Christmas Event. This perk is exclusive to Agents and Andrea.

perks.name: Two units enter battle at one time
perks.info: Unit always comes out of the bus as a pair with identical stats. This perk is exclusive to Agents.

Austin.tagline: Coins won’t be an issue if you bring him to the battle.
Austin.summary: Austin is a ranged Support that functions like a Shooter. He has average stats for his class, with the exception of relatively fast preparation time. He fires his gun in three-round bursts up to four times before performing a fast reload. If approached without ammo, he does a quick melee attack.

perks.name: Gets coins from zombies that have been killed
perks.info: Unit has a chance of granting additional coins after killing an enemy. This perk is exclusive to Austin.

perks.name: High rate of fire
perks.info: Ranged units with a fast firing speed. The exact firing speed varies between each unit, some of them firing faster or slower than the others. Damage is usually dealt quicker than other ranged units but is generally less accurate and more suited for crowd control on groups of weaker enemies. All shooters except Hero, Builder Abby, and Austin possess this perk.

Berserker.tagline: Fast and fearless, strikes terror even into allies.
Berserker.summary: Berserker is a Fighter. His stats are marginally high for his class. He has overall fast attack speed, with criticals being landed slightly quicker than regular attacks. When performing a regular attack, Berserker always does two swings that can't be interrupted.

perks.name: The unit becomes fearless and inspires fear in other units
perks.info: Units have base stats of -300 charisma and 9,999 valor, rendering them virtually immune to the fear debuff while being capable of inspiring it within other units in a radius, similar to enemies. This perk is exclusive to Saw, Berserker, and Queen.

Builder.tagline: Building walls was his main occupation - now he knocks them down.
Builder.summary: Builder is a Damager. His stats are average for his class, though his cost is also somewhat lower. His melee attacks consist of two different wrench swings that are just as slow as each other, while his critical hit is a very fast kick.

perks.name: Knocks the enemy back
perks.info: Pushes enemies back some distance. Some units with this perk can only cause knockback with a critical hit while others can cause knockback with every hit. The distance an enemy is knocked back can vary, though most only push enemies a moderately small distance away. Knockback distance can be partially or completely resisted on certain enemies.

perks.name: Ranged resistance
perks.info: All damage received from ranged sources (excluding Flamethrower, Willy, and Dr. Norman) is reduced by 90%. Turbo is the only unit with full immunity against ranged damage sources. A level 30 Sniper Polina's special ability can ignore 40% of the bullet resistance percentage, while units with the Tactical item set bonus can ignore 50%. Glasses "Glasses (Charm)")/Horseshoe "Horseshoe (Charm)") are charms that allow their corresponding units to ignore 2%-5% bullet resistance. All such effects are multiplicative on the final value but compound additively.

perks.name: Close combat protection
perks.info: Damage received from melee attacks is reduced. Policeman Diaz, Soldier, and all Damagers possess this perk. Policeman Diaz has a 50% resistance while others have only 25%. The Prisoners "Prisoners (Team)") 2/2 Team Power provides all units on said team with 50% melee resistance. This perk cannot exceed 75% resistance.

Builder Abby.summary: Builder Abby is a melee Damager that features elements of a Shooter in her design. She has very low stats for the former class, while possessing incredibly high ranged damage. Her melee swings are slow, and she has no unique animation for critical attacks. She has an incredibly expensive courage cost (the highest in the game currently), but her preparation time is moderate.

perks.name: Becomes a melee unit after running out of ammo
perks.info: Permanently switches to a melee weapon after firing their ranged weapon once. This perk is exclusive to Builder Abby.

Cap.tagline: The fast and unerringly accurate captain of the special unit easily raises morale.

perks.name: Lightning-fast attack
perks.info: Unit will swiftly rush in front of a nearby enemy and deliver a guaranteed critical hit. This perk is exclusive to Carol.

Cashier.tagline: Now he serves smacks instead of snacks.

Chopper.tagline: Woodcutting skills are still useful to this day. Can heal 50% of his health while eating.
Chopper.summary: Chopper is a melee Heavyweight, and has average stats for his class. His attack speed is sluggish, with critical hits being especially slow. His preparation time is one of the highest for a melee unit.

perks.name: Activated ability
perks.info: Special manual ability that can be activated by pressing the yellow icon above the unit's head. After using a unit's manual ability, a cooldown of varying times begins before it can be used again. Chopper eats to heal himself, recovering a total of 50% of his max health in 4 healing pulses. Lionheart unleashes a carpet of fire near him, dealing fire damage and burning corpses. (7 second cooldown.) Welder.tagline: A garage welding kit comes in handy even in the apocalypse.
Welder.summary: Welder is a melee Support unit, who provides strictly utility aid. He has extremely high rage cost and preparation time, along with extremely low health, but also very high movement speed.

perks.name: Only attacks the enemy base
perks.info: Avoids all enemies and heads directly to the barricade to attack it. This perk is exclusive to Welder.

perks.name: It can repair a bus, a turret and a generator
perks.info: Can heal the bus, Turret, and Generator for varying amounts of their maximum health by approaching them. Despite the perk's implicit description, multiple Turrets and Generators can be repaired. This perk is exclusive to Welder.

perks.name: Fire resistance
perks.info: Damage received from fire is reduced. Units with 100% resistance will ignore fire pools completely, but their corpses cannot be burned. Dr. Kane, Dr. Norman, Firefighter, Dr. Miller, Hero and all stationary units with a health bar all possess this perk. Hero is the only one who has 50% resistance.

perks.name: Does not turn into a zombie after death
perks.info: Units killed with their corpse intact will not turn into a zombie. This perk does not prevent Energy Sphere from turning units into Offals. Grenadier, Welder, Flamethrower, and Juggernaut create an explosion and a fire pool when destroyed, which damage both enemies and allies. Soldier, Cap, Swat, and Rogue simply fall after their death. Specops will do a last-ditch attack by firing three more shots as he dies.

Willy.tagline: A soldier equipped with a shield, a bulletproof suit and a stun gun.
Willy.summary: Willy is a ranged Heavyweight that fights in close quarters. He has low health and damage for his class, along with higher-than-average courage cost. Meanwhile, his preparation time is relatively short overall.

perks.name: Additional defense against damage
perks.info: Unit always starts with a set amount of SP (Shield Points) on top of their regular health. This perk is shared between Willy and Juggernaut, both of whom are heavyweights.

perks.name: Stuns the enemy
perks.info: Greatly slows the enemy down. There are two forms of the stun effect; the first is an electrical zap that very briefly stops the target completely, and the second is a freezing effect that heavily restricts movement and attack speeds. Both effects are vital to activating the Ice Breaker "Ice Breaker (Item Set)") item set bonus as it gives users a 30% increase to their damage against afflicted enemies. Jailer, Willy, and Rogue utilize the former stun method while Nitrogen and Dr. Norman utilize the latter.

perks.name: Knocks the enemy back
perks.info: Pushes enemies back some distance. Some units with this perk can only cause knockback with a critical hit while others can cause knockback with every hit. The distance an enemy is knocked back can vary, though most only push enemies a moderately small distance away. Knockback distance can be partially or completely resisted on certain enemies.

perks.name: Ranged resistance
perks.info: All damage received from ranged sources (excluding Flamethrower, Willy, and Dr. Norman) is reduced by 90%. Turbo is the only unit with full immunity against ranged damage sources. A level 30 Sniper Polina's special ability can ignore 40% of the bullet resistance percentage, while units with the Tactical item set bonus can ignore 50%. Glasses "Glasses (Charm)")/Horseshoe "Horseshoe (Charm)") are charms that allow their corresponding units to ignore 2%-5% bullet resistance. All such effects are multiplicative on the final value but compound additively.
